messages.message: ORDER-104 (desk lamp, 2500 USD cents): Full refund was issued on day 4 for "parcel not received," but the delivery record shows the parcel was delivered to the recipient on day 5. Since the customer retains the item, the refund has been repaid to you (2500 cents, refund_repaid=true). No return shipment was made — returning the parcel is not permitted once the refund is repaid, and the customer keeps the lamp they have now paid for. Please close this order as: item delivered, payment retained by retailer, no outstanding balance or return expected.
